title: Glimpse of Vietnam with FREE Nha Trang Island Tour
highlights: Dive into Vietnam’s vibrant culture and stunning landscapes from sailing through Halong Bay’s limestone formations to cycling in the scenic villages of Ninh Binh.
Sail through Halong Bay on the Dragon Cruise, explore Sung Sot Grotto, kayak at Luon Cave, and enjoy panoramic views from Titop Island.
Hop between Mun, Mot, and Tam Islands, enjoying coral reefs, beach relaxation, a Floating Wine Party, and water sports.
Explore ancient Hoa Lu temples, sail through Tam Coc’s stunning landscapes, and cycle to the Bich Dong pagoda complex.
Experience the blend of history, culture, and natural beauty of Vietnam from Halong Bay’s limestone caves to Ninh Binh’s tranquil villages.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival, get transferred from the airport to your hotel. Later, feel free to unwind or venture out on your own to explore the city's notable attractions. You can visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum to delve into Vietnam's historical journey. For picturesque spots, head to the Lake of the Restored Sword. Additionally, a trip to Bat Trang Ceramic Village offers a wonderful opportunity to shop for unique souvenirs. Return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Day Cruise
days.desc: Get transferred from the hotel to the Tuan Chau Harbor for the famous Halong Bay Day Cruise. Board the Dragon Cruise, and enjoy a Vietnamese seafood lunch while passing iconic rock formations. Explore Sung Sot Grotto, Halong Bay's largest cave, and visit Luon Cave with options for kayaking and bamboo boat rides. Discover Titop Island and trek to its peak for stunning views. Return to Halong Harbor and take the provided transfers to reach your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Nha Trang
days.desc: Check-out from the Hanoi hotel and get transferred to the airport. Board a flight to Nha Trang (Tickets Included). Upon arrival, take the provided transfer to reach your pre-booked hotel and check-in. You can rest or visit places like Ponagar Temple, a historical and cultural monument, Hon Chong Beach, and so on. You can also visit Pagoda Long Son, well known for its substantial white Buddha picture. After exploring the city on your own, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nha Trang Island Tour
days.desc: Get transferred from the hotel to Cau Da Port and start your island-hopping adventure from  Mun Island with its pristine beaches and coral reefs. Next, visit the Mot Island for tranquil beaches and entertaining performances. Enjoy a Floating Wine Party on board before heading to Tam Island for beach relaxation, water sports, and exploring the Old House and golf yard. Conclude with a Tropical Fruits Party on the deck. Later, take the provided transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, explore Vietnam’s rich heritage and natural wonders on a Ninh Binh day trip. Take the provided transfer from the hotel and start by visiting Hoa Lu’s ancient temples, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Enjoy a delicious lunch in Tam Coc, known as "Halong Bay on Land," followed by a peaceful boat ride through karst landscapes and limestone caves. Cycle through scenic villages to the picturesque Bich Dong Pagoda complex. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
